summary: Repaired the previously incomplete advertising-request task by adding permission-aware persistent administrator list/detail HTTP projections. GET /api/v1/admin/ad-requests and GET /api/v1/admin/ad-requests/:adRequestId now query the Mongoose ad_requests collection with bounded filters, deterministic ordering, pagination, and latest-quote hydration while excluding request history, storage keys, payment-proof data, and unrelated internals.
